_comment: Default sandbox roots + image catalog for bears-sandbox-provider (SANDBOX_ROOTS_CONFIG). The catalog is the trust boundary: dispatch selects images by name, and only images listed here can run. Build these tags into the engine with `docker compose --profile sandbox-build run --rm bears-sandbox-images`, or replace them with registry references. Add roots for the git upstreams jobs may work on; see docs/guides/sandbox-server-ops.md for the credential shapes. Override this file per deployment via SANDBOX_ROOTS_FILE.

images.name: base
images.description: Debian slim + armature, git, curl, ripgrep

images.description: base + rustup stable toolchain, clippy, rustfmt

images.description: base + Godot editor binary and export templates (godot --headless)
